criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered, dark and staged, the bold register holds. Best frames 9, 6 and 1. Several still lean on primitive or default models: 4 a stock monitor in a teal gradient void with a mid grey mesh screen and slab books; 3 a flat cyan ring lens, a pale faceted shape behind the pod, stretched bark; 1 a firewood load and floating leaf cards from the culled limbs; 5 a bar chart in sticks square on; 8 the label's last letters on the upright; 7 a blocky kit truck with a mannequin. Per frame about 7.5, 7, 6, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 7, 6.5, 8.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A stock monitor and slab books in a teal gradient void, a mid grey mesh screen, the largest mid tone block.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A built office over a reviewer's shoulder, an emissive screen as the brightest value and only source, the books deleted.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A cartoon ring lens, a pale faceted shape behind the pod, stretched bark, an empty top.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Recessed coated glass with one highlight, cyan only on the lamp, the boom culled, the camera dropped against the lit body side.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The label's last letters on the upright, a flat cyan tag, a dead left half.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The label on two lines ending clear of the upright, a paper stock tag with a cast, the camera in and down on the bare arm.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A bar chart drawn in sticks square on, labels over busy fence.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rotate about 25 degrees off square and lower, tapered bent limbs, the fence a stop darker behind the labels.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A firewood load, a rust brown body, floating leaf cards.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Branchy brush with small leaves, cull the orphaned cards, swing to catch the white cab.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A brown-mauve haze in the top third, primitive box cabs.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Fog to the near black sky above the far rows, a chamfered hood and windscreen on the instanced cab.
